sentence: This project provides researchers with access to computing hardware and software for simulation and machine learning in areas such as renewable energy and cybersecurity.
This project builds tools that rebuild the evolutionary history of a tumor from single-cell sequencing data.
This project studies where cosmic rays come from and how they behave in the atmosphere, using detectors in clear ice and at the surface.
This project builds learning methods that help many autonomous decision-makers learn to act safely without a central coordinator.
This project tries to find out how microplastics change the way soil, water and plants interact on agricultural farms.
This project studies how ponds in Arctic wetlands release methane and how they have changed over the past 50 years.
This project designs and builds a wireless network that gives a university campus fast connectivity and serves as a research platform.
This project studies how one protein that works with adhesion proteins helps epithelial cells survive by controlling many genes.
This project builds gel materials that support the growth of patient cells into small tissue spheres called organoids.
This project studies how arctic ground squirrels respond to warming during hibernation and whether their behavior affects how well they cope with climate change.
This project studies how precision touch varies across primates and other mammals and which genes and cells are linked to it.
This project develops mathematical methods to study nonlinear partial differential equations and uses them to model traffic and portfolio selection.
This project uses deep learning to design stacked two-dimensional materials with controlled twist angles and then makes and measures them.
This project studies how nanoparticles and polymers mix in composite materials and how polymers fill porous scaffolds.
This project plans a shared design process for science and engineering challenges that use AI tools for coding and problem-solving.
This project builds a light-based method to hold single molecules and measure how electricity moves through them.
